title: Structured Programming: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B.

parts.text: Explain why the use of comments in C programs is generally considered to be good programming practice.
Briefly describe: i. abort() ii. rand() iii. qsort() iv. abs()
Explain what an data type is and list the examples of data types.
Describe the importance of C standard library.
Illustrate using a C code whether how a pointers is defined and assigned values .
Explain how a structure different from a union?

The straight line method of computing the yearly turnover of a company is given by: Turnover = Sales - Expenses No. of Months Write a Program to determine the Profit per month when the sales, months of operation and the annual expenditure is availed.

An election is contested by 8 candidates. The candidate are numbered are 1 to 8 and the voting is done by marking the candidate number on the ballot paper. Write a program to enable voting for the 8 candidates by clicking a radio button. No one should be allowed to vote for more than 1 candidate. Write a code to facilitate the above.
Describe three types of errors encountered in C programming. Give example in each category.
Given that if (day = =1) printf("Monday"); else if(point = =2) printf("Tue"); else if(point = =3) printf("Wednesday"); else printf("Its not Sunday Yet"); Rewrite the above program in switch case form
Illustrate the usage of sizeof() operator
Define storage class. Explain how any two of storage classes are used in C.
Convert the following expression in c language. (y4*5)-(x4) R= 3x3 + x
With a valid example, give the relationship between the following terms.
An operator
An operand.
An expression
What is operator precedence?
A programmer encountered the following error messages on compiling a program:
Stack overflow
Statement missing Kindly explain how to debug the above errors?
Give three features of a structure.
Give the meaning of the following declarations;
char Fname[16];
int num_emp;
double intake, BBIT;
char response;
Define the term Operator.
Describe with examples, four relational operators
Write a function to calculate volume of a Cylinder. The function accepts two arguments representing the radius and height.
Explain three types of escape sequences. Illustrate in a program to show their usage in C language.
Describe the four basic data types in C while giving the memory requirement and format specifier for each data type.
Declare a pointer to an array

Using an array, write a program that prompts the user to input his bio data for the date/month/year of birth compute the age based on current year. The program should display the Year of Birth, age, birthday in terms of dd/mm/yy and a birthday congratulation message on the eventual date.
